problem: What are the coordinates of the vertex of the parabola ${y}^{2}=-8x?$
worked_solution:
The standard equation of a left- or right-opening parabola that has its vertex at the origin is

$$
{y}^{2}=4px,
$$

where $p$ is a constant.

We can rewrite the given equation as 

$$
{y}^{2}=4(-2)x.
$$

It is now clear that our equation is of the standard type with $p=-2.$ Therefore, our parabola has its vertex at $(0,0).$
